parameters.name: streamID
parameters.description: The id of the stream you want to access. Make sure that you are URI encoding the streamId

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of articles/entries to return. Pick a number between 1 and 100 (optional, default is 20)

parameters.name: newerThan
parameters.description: Long timestamp in ms representing the time of your previous call (in Unix/Epoch). Cannot be older than 31 days ago. (optional)

parameters.name: olderThan
parameters.description: Long timestamp in ms representing the time of your previous call (in Unix/Epoch). (optional)

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: An id is used to page through the articles. The continuation id will be returned as part of each call response. This is useful if you want to fetch more articles than the count = 100 limit (optional)

parameters.name: includeAiActions
parameters.description: if true, AI Actions from articles will be returned.

parameters.name: similar
parameters.description: if true, numRelatedEntries will be returned
